name: Feeld (iOS)
description: Open-minded dating, dark-native. True-black canvas #000000 with one rationed acid-yellow #E8FF63 accent, desire pink #FF5C8A, a full-bleed 28pt Discover card with couple-aware names and a heavy rgba(0,0,0,0.72)→0.92 gradient, plus the three-state Desire chip system.
